elements.label: Figure B1.3.1
elements.title: Number of Low-, Middle-, and High-Income Countries Covered in International Debt Report 2026, by FY27 Income and Lending Groups
elements.description: The chart shows countries covered by the report by FY27 lending and income groups. IDA-only countries total 54, IBRD-only countries 47, and blend countries 19. The largest printed segment is the 47 middle-income IBRD-only countries; the smallest is the single high-income IDA-only country.
elements.notes: Sources: World Bank Group, “World Bank Country and Lending Groups,” https://datahelpdesk.worldbank.org/knowledgebase/articles/906519-world-bank-country-and-lending-groups; World Bank Group IDA, https://ida.worldbank.org/en/home. Note: IBRD = International Bank for Reconstruction and Development; IDA = International Development Association; FY = fiscal year.
